reviewed: implementer-out/diff.patch against TASK.md (T4) and prototypes/go surrounding code
verdict: Correct, minimal root-cause fix (os.Lstat -> os.Stat in profile.Load); K14 safeguards intact (Stat regular check, O_NONBLOCK open, fstat + IsRegular + SameFile re-check). Both call sites (profile show, tui) go through Load. No defects of blocker or major severity.

results: relative symlink to homelab.toml: exit 0 PROFILE_OK
symlink to FIFO: exit 2 USAGE_ERROR (no block, under a 5 s alarm)

defects.description: Re-implements the Stat/open/fstat sequence instead of exercising Load's own re-check; the final Load(link) call is rejected by the up-front Stat, so removing the fstat/SameFile re-check from Load would not turn any test red. Also calls t.Errorf from a goroutine that can outlive the test after the 2 s t.Fatal timeout (would panic 'Log in goroutine after Test has completed').

'symlink to symlink to fifo' targets filepath.Join(dir, "link-symlink to fifo"), silently coupling to the 'link-'+name naming of another map entry; it works only because dangling links can be created in any map order. Fragile for future edits.
The 2 s bound is measured around runTUIFile, which includes pty setup and 10 ms polling, and the case does not assert the USAGE_ERROR message; adequate but loose.

notes: O_NOCTTY addition is harmless defence in depth on darwin/linux; not required by the bug.
REPORT.md K14 row now contains both the old Lstat-era sentence and the post-round note; readable but slightly layered.
Spec items not applicable here: T2 ASCII case folding (this is T4).
